name: modcut
description: Modern cross-platform laser control for Horten Folkeverksted (a modernized VisiCut).
author: Horten Folkeverksted

scripts.bundle: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:runtime
scripts.test:main: node --test electron/test-window-lifecycle.mjs electron/test-recovery-store.mjs electron/test-project-store.mjs electron/test-import-formats.mjs electron/test-font-service.mjs
scripts.test:renderer: node --test renderer/test-engraving-recipe.mjs renderer/test-hpglimport.mjs renderer/test-job-split.mjs renderer/test-lengthToMm.mjs renderer/test-layer-model.mjs renderer/test-motion-timing.mjs renderer/test-output-quality.mjs renderer/test-pdf-vector.mjs renderer/test-process-profiles.mjs renderer/test-raster-processing.mjs renderer/test-toolpath-policy.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:sidecar && node electron/e2e/run.mjs && node electron/e2e/run.mjs --draw
scripts.test: npm run test:sidecar && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:main && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:draw && npm run check:contrast && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pack: npm run bundle && electron-builder --dir && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-font-package.mjs
